claims.quote: Homalopteroides weberi is a hillstream loach from Sarawak in Malaysian Borneo, described from the Akar River and possibly endemic to the state.
Type locality is 'Akar River, Sarawak state, Borneo, East Malaysia', and this species may be endemic to the Malaysian state of Sarawak in western Borneo.
